Every feature and setting is on. Android now asks for each permission on its own screens, one after another; Bridgit moves on by itself. Skip one and it goes on to the next; anything still off is listed here at the end, with Try again.

Every feature and setting is on and %1$s may use all of them. Android now asks for each permission on its own screens, one after another; Bridgit moves on by itself. Skip one and it goes on to the next; anything still off is listed here at the end, with Try again.

Lets control agents change brightness and other phone settings for a while.
Lets Bridgit come to the front when a control agent sends a question or card.

Another permission a Bridgit feature uses.

Set up ADB once (tap here) and Max Agentic Control turns these on by itself, with no switches to flip.
Every feature and setting is on. Turn off to switch every feature off; control agents stay paired.
Turn on for every feature and setting, then each Android permission in one pass
Turns on every feature and setting, then walks you through each Android permission in one pass, so your control agents can do everything this phone allows.

On the next screen, turn on %1$s and confirm Android’s access warning.

If you see the Accessibility menu instead, tap Installed apps (or Downloaded apps / Installed services), then %1$s. Turn on the main service switch; the accessibility shortcut is optional.

If it is blocked as a restricted setting, go back to Bridgit and use Allow restricted settings. When finished, return to Bridgit if it does not reopen.
Turn on notification access for %1$s and confirm Allow. If Android shows a list, select %1$s first. Return to Bridgit if it does not reopen.
Turn on Allow display over other apps for %1$s (sometimes called Appear on top). If Android shows a list, select %1$s first. Then return to Bridgit.
Choose Allow for %1$s to run without battery optimisation. If Android shows a list, select All apps, find %1$s, and choose Don’t optimise. Then return to Bridgit.
Turn on Allow usage tracking for %1$s. If Android shows a list, select %1$s first. Return to Bridgit if it does not reopen.
Turn on Allow modifying system settings for %1$s. If Android shows a list, select %1$s first. Return to Bridgit if it does not reopen.
Allow Do Not Disturb access for %1$s and confirm Allow. If Android shows a list, select %1$s first. Return to Bridgit if it does not reopen.
Turn on Allow from this source for %1$s, so Bridgit can offer its own updates. Android may close Bridgit when this changes; reopen Bridgit to finish.
In Health Connect, allow the health records you want %1$s to read. Use Allow all if you want every listed record type, then return to Bridgit.
Turn on Allow notifications for %1$s. Keep its capture notifications enabled, so camera and microphone use stays visible. Then return to Bridgit.
Choose Allow all the time for Location so %1$s can provide location while in the background. If App info opens, tap Permissions → Location. Then return to Bridgit.
Tap Permissions, choose the access shown above, and allow it. Then return to Bridgit. You can leave any access off.
Finish the items below to enable every feature and setting.
